links.reason: Deploy uses AWS/GHCR registry credentials alongside the AWS access keys config.
Deploy pipeline builds the image that runs with the Postgres main database config (port 5432, username).
Deploy pipeline bundles the Redis dependency (port 6379) used by the application.
Deployed image writes to the logger.file path /app/logs/ defined in the logger config.
Deploy workflow publishes the REST server (port 3000, secretKey) image.
Both are external cloud service integrations referenced from the same config loader.
Cron job (monthlyFee) executes against the Postgres database.
Server port 3000 connects to the Postgres main database on port 5432.
Server port 3000 connects to the Redis instance on port 6379.
Logger is bootstrapped from the server runtime.
Both Saungwa WhatsApp and Brevo are outbound notification integrations loaded by the same config loader.
Role identifiers are enforced by the REST server's auth middleware (secretKey).
